summary: Implemented the LMCache MP request-finish non-blocking store contract using the connector's real store_kv_async MessagingFuture[bool] API from merged LMCache PR 4152. MP radix nodes remain locked until future.result() resolves at eviction, reset, or graceful shutdown; completion then releases the node, clears the load-back marker, and ends the session. Submission failures, false results, exceptional futures, and connector-close failures retain deterministic cleanup and surface errors. The IP stream synchronization path is preserved through the shared reconciliation boundary.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before evidence: the recorded base has no async MP store call and still invokes blocking store_kv.

Seven lifecycle regressions passed: non-blocking submission, lock retention, completion-before-eviction/slot-reuse ordering, submission failure cleanup, false and exceptional future cleanup, reset drain, graceful shutdown drain, marker/session cleanup, and unchanged IP synchronization.
Changed production and regression-test Python sources compile successfully.
Broader test collection was environment-blocked before tests ran because the frozen Triton installation lacks triton._C.libtriton.linear_layout; raw traceback retained.

gpu_execution_evidence: The assigned ROCm GPU is visible (torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, HIP 7.2, one device), but LMCache is not installed in the mandated interpreter, so no real LMCache connector/daemon GPU execution was possible. The focused lifecycle tests use controlled futures and do not claim GPU integration coverage.
remaining_limitations: The mandated interpreter has no lmcache module or distribution, so the merged LMCache PR 4152 connector and a live daemon could not be exercised end-to-end.

The connector API was verified from merged LMCache commit f7fffc186687d710a711ba6e8f48f0af6716fb8d and retained under reports/j-d1df881a2124/raw, but that dependency was not installed or substituted into the frozen GPU stack.
The existing radix-cache unit suite cannot collect in this environment because the pinned Triton package lacks triton._C.libtriton.linear_layout.
ruff and black are not installed in the mandated interpreter; py_compile and git diff --check were used instead.
